# OpenAI 宣布推出 SearchGPT

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2024-07-29 14:01（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1817802525229174986
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

@wilreynolds 2. 如果你还不知道，OpenAI 已宣布推出 SearchGPT。可以加入候补名单。更多细节见 @gofishchris：
https://x.com/gofishchris/status/1816806661689938234

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Chris Long @chris_nectiv](<https://x.com/chris_nectiv/status/1816806661689938234>)

重磅消息：OpenAI 刚刚宣布推出由 AI 驱动的搜索引擎 SearchGPT。

Google 现在有了一个非常强大的竞争对手。

以下是目前我们对 SearchGPT 的了解：

- 与 Google 类似，SearchGPT 看起来有一个非常简洁的界面。
- SearchGPT 指出现有搜索体验中的阻力：通过当前的搜索获取信息，“往往需要尝试多次才能得到相关结果”。它的目标是让搜索体验“更快、更轻松”。
- SearchGPT 将其 AI 模型与网络数据结合来工作。
- 👏它似乎也很重视注明来源。SearchGPT 提到，这个平台会为你提供“指向相关来源的清晰链接”。👏
- 它还强调更具对话感的搜索方式，并展示了在后续追问时，无须重复输入最初的查询。
- SearchGPT 目前仍处于原型阶段，仅向部分用户开放。你可以在它的网站上报名加入候补名单。

总体而言，我认为这对营销人员和整个互联网都是好事：

网站所有者将多一个可以分发内容的平台。

SEO 从业者将多一个值得学习和优化的新领域。

更多竞争可能会迫使 Google 重新思考其极其激进的广告策略，以及有限的来源标注。

就我个人而言，我非常期待看到 SearchGPT。

## 英文原文

@wilreynolds 2. If you don't know this yet, OpenAI announced SearchGPT. Join the wait list. More details via @gofishchris: 
https://x.com/gofishchris/status/1816806661689938234

### Quoted preview

[Chris Long @chris_nectiv](<https://x.com/chris_nectiv/status/1816806661689938234>)

Huge news: OpenAI just announced SearchGPT, an AI-powered search engine. 

Google now has a very powerful competitor. 

Here's what we know about SearchGPT so far: 

- Similar to Google, SearchGPT seems to have a very simple interface.
- SearchGPT addresses the current friction of the search experience by calling out that getting information through current search "often requiring multiple attempts to get relevant results". The goal of their experience is to be "faster and easier" 
- SearchGPT works by combining their AI models with data from the web.
- 👏They also seems to be emphasizing attribution. SearchGPT mentions how the platform will give you "clear links to relevant sources"👏 
- They also emphasize the more conversational approach to search, showing that follow up responses don't require repeat entry of the initial query. 
- SearchGPT is currently in prototype and will only be available to select users. You can opt in to the waitlist on their site. 

Overall, I think this is a great thing for marketers and the web alike: 

Site owners will have another platform that can distribute their content. 

SEOs will have another space to learn and optimize againt

More competition might force Google to rethink it's extremely aggressive approach to ads and limited attribution. 

I for one am very excited to see SearchGPT.
